title: REQ · BootScene SHUTDOWN calls and clears the transitionTo unsubscribe
summary: SHUTDOWN handler invokes unsubscribeTransition then sets it to null
description: Context: the SHUTDOWN callback registered in create already calls unsubscribeTransition?.() and nulls it at L97-L98. Desired behavior: after shutdown no transitionTo event reaches BootScene, while other subscribers keep working. Expected result: no fade or scene start after shutdown. Why: avoids duplicate handlers after restart.
acceptance_criteria: Given the SHUTDOWN callback has run, when transitionTo is emitted, then fadeOut and scene.start are not called
Given another subscriber registered before create, when SHUTDOWN has run and transitionTo is emitted, then that subscriber still receives the payload

in_scope: transitionTo release in the SHUTDOWN handler
preserve: order and behavior of the other cleanup calls

technical_constraints: Release must happen inside the existing SHUTDOWN handler
definition_of_done: unsubscribeTransition is called and set to null in SHUTDOWN
